method: Manual native-coordinate polygon trace from only the actual K3/v1 photograph. Rasterized with Pillow without resizing or antialiasing. White denotes visible palace roofs/facades; black denotes everything else.
blindness: No source renders, target/reference masks, camera files, prompts, previous images or metrics were inspected.
included: Palace roofs and facades including shadowed vertical faces.
excluded: Large open western court; eastern enclosed court floor including statue; visible floors of the two narrow foreground recesses; city buildings, greenery, river, streets and other surroundings.

uncertainEdges.detail: Distant northern roof ornaments and facade foot have about 1-4 pixel uncertainty.
Eastern oblique roof edge has fine details and local partial occlusions; about 2-5 pixel uncertainty.
Eastern court ground/wall boundary and south roof projection manually estimated; about 2-4 pixel uncertainty. All visible shadowed walls retained.
Narrow foreground court floor strips are shadowed and partly roof-occluded; exact floor contact about 3-5 pixels uncertain.
Foreground fine ornaments, spires and facade ground contact have about 1-4 pixel uncertainty.
